entries.name: Upright Barbell Row
entries.reason: Source-bound front-view draft. Standing tall with the bar against the thighs and the hands slightly narrower than the shoulders; the hands travel straight up the front of the body toward the chin while the elbows rise up and out to the sides and finish higher than the hands, a pause, and a slower lowering to the thighs. The trunk and legs do not move. Drawn from a 3D model: with a narrow grip the elbows cannot be straight out to the sides, so they come up and out a little forward of the shoulders, which a front view shows as out. Not drawn: how close the bar is to the body, which only a side view shows, and the overhand grip.
entries.summary: Standing tall with a narrow overhand grip, lift the bar from the thighs toward the chin with the elbows leading up and out, higher than the hands, pause, then lower slowly.

frames.caption: Stand tall holding a barbell against the thighs with an overhand grip slightly narrower than the shoulders.
Keeping the bar close to the body, lift it toward the chin by raising the elbows up and out to the sides, elbows higher than the hands.
Pause at the top. Elbows lead and stay above the hands.
Lower the bar slowly to the thighs.
Bar stays close to the body.

entries.name: Upright Row - With Bands
entries.reason: Source-bound front-view draft. Standing on the middle of a band with an end in each hand against the thighs; the hands travel straight up the front of the body toward the chin while the elbows rise up and out to the sides and finish higher than the hands, a pause, and a slower lowering against the band. Each end of the band runs from under a foot to the hand above it and stretches as the hands rise. The trunk and legs do not move. Not drawn: how close the hands are to the body, which only a side view shows, and the palms facing the body.
entries.summary: Standing on a band with an end in each hand, lift the hands from the thighs toward the chin with the elbows leading up and out, higher than the hands, pause, then lower slowly.

frames.caption: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand against the thighs with the palms facing the body.
Keeping the hands close to the body, lift them toward the chin by raising the elbows up and out to the sides, elbows higher than the hands.
Pause at the top. Elbows lead and stay above the hands.
Lower slowly to the thighs, against the band.
Hands stay close to the body.
